# Copilot Instructions

Use the repository-wide instructions in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) as the source of truth.

Before working, read:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/PROJECT_MEMORY.md`
- `replit.md`
- Relevant documentation and artifact files

Follow the security, minimal-change, testing, workflow, and memory-maintenance rules in `AGENTS.md`. Do not modify Secrets, environment variables, tokens, or external GitHub/Vercel/Supabase/Firebase settings without explicit user approval.
